Ralph Lauren.master_prompt: A slender model with natural, minimal makeup and loosely waved hair stands in a confident, relaxed pose with one foot forward, holding a small clutch. She wears a knee-length navy blue sequined dress with a gold chain pattern, layered under an open brown velvet coat. The dress texture is a mix of shimmering sequins and smooth velvet, with a pair of strappy gold sandals. The setting is a minimalist room with white walls, classic crown molding, and light herringbone wood floors, illuminated by soft, natural window light. The shot is a full-body photograph.
Ralph Lauren.lighting: Golden hour, soft directional sunlight, warm glow
Ralph Lauren.model_style: Classic American, country club, wind-swept hair, natural makeup
Ralph Lauren.pose: Relaxed, candid, walking outdoors, looking away
Ralph Lauren.environment: Polo field, Hamptons estate, classic architecture

Liu Jo.master_prompt: A full-length studio photograph of a model with dark, shoulder-length hair and a fringe, standing against a seamless white background. She wears a camel-colored knit turtleneck dress with pockets, a black leather jacket slung over her shoulder, and black knee-high boots. She holds a small black leather handbag. The lighting is soft, even studio light, highlighting the ribbed texture of the knitwear and the smooth leather. Her expression is neutral. The overall feel is chic, modern, and tailored.
Liu Jo.lighting: High contrast, studio flash, bright and crisp
Liu Jo.model_style: Italian glamour, confident, sharp eyeliner, sleek hair
Liu Jo.pose: Dynamic, strong angles, hand on hip, direct eye contact
Liu Jo.environment: Minimalist studio, urban street, chic interior

Zara.master_prompt: A medium shot fashion photograph of a model with strong, angular features and dark hair in a sleek low bun, standing in semi-profile against a stark minimalist white studio wall. She wears a tailored, matte black crepe midi dress with a structured square neckline and short sleeves. Her gaze is neutral. Bright, clean studio lighting casts a sharp, defined shadow on the pale grey concrete floor behind her.
Zara.lighting: Harsh flash, direct lighting, slight underexposure on background
Zara.model_style: Edgy, contemporary, minimalist makeup, structured hair
Zara.environment: Blank studio wall, raw concrete, abstract backgrounds

Liverpool.master_prompt: A full-body fashion photograph of a tall woman with brown hair standing poised against a seamless white studio background. She wears an elegant, floor-length evening gown combining black sequins, gold brocade patterns, and deep blue chiffon, featuring feather-trimmed sleeves and a beaded V-neckline. Her hands are casually clasped in front. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the rich, textured fabric and the subtle shimmer of the sequins. She wears minimalist silver heels and delicate gold hoop earrings.
Liverpool.lighting: Bright, even studio lighting, high key
Liverpool.model_style: Approachable, diverse, commercial commercial, everyday wear
Liverpool.environment: Clean color backdrops, simple lifestyle settings

Neiman Marcus.master_prompt: A full-length studio fashion photograph set against a seamless, light grey background with soft, diffused studio lighting. A female model with a slender build stands facing forward, her arms relaxed by her sides. She wears an elegant, mid-length dress featuring a draped or wrapped silhouette, crafted from a luxurious, textured fabric like silk or jacquard. The dress, in a rich color like deep blue, red, or pink with floral patterns or embroidered details, is accessorized with minimalist heels. Her hair is neatly styled, and she wears minimal jewelry.
Neiman Marcus.lighting: Soft spotlight, dramatic shadows, premium studio glow
Neiman Marcus.pose: Statuesque, elegant, showcasing the garment structure
Neiman Marcus.environment: Luxurious textures, velvet drapery, marble floors

Nordstrom.master_prompt: A full-length fashion photograph of a full-figured woman with long, dark wavy hair, posing against a seamless white studio background with bright, even light and soft shadows. She stands with one hand confidently on her hip, wearing a shimmering metallic gold satin off-the-shoulder gown. The dress features elegant draping, a ruched bodice, and a high side slit revealing her leg, with clear heeled sandals. Her expression is poised and confident. The fabric catches the light, emphasizing its smooth, liquid-like texture.
Nordstrom.lighting: Clean, bright, natural looking studio light
Nordstrom.pose: Standard ecommerce, clear front/side views, friendly
